description:
At continuation entry, read captures and the outer continuation into registers, then if the frame ends at bump_top and no ValueRef capture is scalar-kinded (pinned), set bump_top to the frame start. Write the resumed-once rule down where the continuation kinds are defined (collections only at quantum end; runnable and park record are taken on resume; a try handler captures the outer K and is popped before K resumes).
Measured: tail loop 1M iterations 4M frames popped, collections 1000->52; distiller 32k minor collections 752->290, peak 303->239 MB.
Acceptance: a poison mode becomes a test over the native paths of the matrix, with the late-read positive control proving it catches a use after resume; pop hits/misses/pinned reported as heap statistics.
Proposal (approved 2026-11-14): https://claude.ai/artifact/94aN2YPxunzwVEzct26nz2 (local /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-d7w.html). Spike evidence: worktree ../fz-hc, branch exp/heap-cont-reads (uncommitted, FZ_SPIKE_* switches).
